## Summary
- 08/27: Packers signed TE Jonnu Smith, who spent last season with the Steelers, to a one-year deal. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7091965/2026/08/27/packers-sign-jonnu-smith-tight-end/) — also [PennLive](https://www.pennlive.com/steelers/2026/08/green-bay-packers-scoop-up-former-pittsburgh-steelers-tight-end.html)

- 08/27: Packers RB Josh Jacobs was formally charged with misdemeanor battery and criminal damage to property from his May arrest; Green Bay's GM addressed possible NFL suspension. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/49745245/packers-star-rb-josh-jacobs-charged-two-misdemeanors) — also [Schefter](https://x.com/AdamSchefter/status/2093067508831916460)
- 08/28: NFL moved its 2026 roster cutdown deadline to Sunday — the first time since 2004 — to accommodate the 49ers and Rams traveling to Australia for their Week 1 game. [CBS Sports](https://www.cbssports.com/nfl/news/why-nfls-2026-cut-deadline-is-being-held-on-a-sunday-for-the-first-time-in-22-years/)
